The seven checks with measured detail, the contract assertions, a ## doc on every declaration and the 36 proven defects did not fit; the generic part (Rounds, judging, Flag runs, check filing) is in the kit as the slice allows, and no check was dropped. Both files are over the TD-006 guide by the same kind of margin the Story 005 to 007 slices were accepted at.

T24 does not start its own Round: it goes on in the Round T23 left running (Player 1's Gyrocopter, Truck and Buggy Tokens gone, both Motorbikes in play, so the stock is genuinely 'in play': [5,0,0,0] and [5,3,2,2]); nine Rounds in all (T18 1, T19 2, T20 3, T21 1, T22 1, T23+T24 1). T24 fails with its own message if T23 left the Round over, paused or a Unit out of play.

T23 spends the combat types in the data's reverse order (Gyrocopter x2, Truck x2, Buggy x3, the counts read from the stock) and Player 1 chooses a Gyrocopter as its first Unit, so the Motorbike count stays at the whole stock; no type name or index is typed in either file (the carrier comes from the data via carrier_index()).

T24's empty ground tank is a real run dry, not a staged one: Player 2's Motorbike is put against the back wall of its own Base (Base-local 0,0,11) with the throttle held; 1501 ticks burn out its 50 Fuel, then 10 s more with the tank empty and the throttle still held. The Round's own lack of any crash for a ground Unit is what is asserted; the data was not touched.

Added beyond the design's list, each with a seeded defect that proves it: every Round start checks the Tokens equal the stock, both Players choosing, nothing over, no winner, tree not paused (AC-7 restart, L23/L27/L32) and each Unit in play within MatchController.SPAWN_SETTLE_TICKS + 2 ticks of its choice (L28, measured 0 or 1); every lockstep prelude checks the counts 4,3,2,1 and that the Round runs after each Self-destruct (all of T18..T22); T20's mixed Round asserts the contract facts (PlayerMatchInput priority -1 < MatchController 0, Shot priority 0 under World, World child 0 before the MatchController child 3, both destructions 8 frames after the Shot node, signal order destroyed:0 destroyed:1 over:-1); T21 measures that Tab and Enter really went down on adjacent ticks (N and N+1); T24 also asserts the engine log of the whole run is empty (L30/L31).

Not asserted here because the matrix gives it to other slices: the Round-over screen texts (token_ui T29), the HUD and panels after a loss (token_ui, token_choice). The three order dependent defects (L14, L15, L21) show the tree-order contract fails loudly in T20.
